title: DelhiCrimeDashboard: Delhi Urban Safety Observatory
description: A district-level crime, road-safety and infrastructure dashboard for Delhi, India, with an interactive map and manifest-documented, checksummed yearly research releases for programmatic reuse. This repository is a compilation, not a primary source: cite the original agency report (NCRB, Delhi Traffic Police) named in each figure's manifest or in docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.
